items: 3-4 lb potatoes, boiled, peeled, and coarsely shredded
1 can (10 oz) cream of chicken (or cream of mushroom) soup

ingredients.title: Optional topping
items: Crushed cornflakes, seasoned bread crumbs, crushed potato chips, or crushed Ritz or saltine crackers
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté until the onion is translucent. Remove from heat.
Add the potatoes, sour cream, cream of chicken soup, cheese, salt, parsley, and pepper and combine well. Add additional salt and pepper if necessary.
Spread the mixture into a 9x13-inch (or similar) dish and bake for 50-60 minutes or until the casserole is hot in the center and the cheese is bubbly throughout.

notes.title: Open questions
